lesson_yaml:
schema: cairn/lesson/v0.1
id: typescript-onboard-untrusted-discovery-endpoint-used-without-confirmation
title: Bonjour-discovered gateway host used to build wss URL without user trust confirmation
summary: 'A gateway endpoint learned from unauthenticated LAN discovery (Bonjour/mDNS) is turned directly
  into a

  suggested remote URL (`wss://host:port`) and later saved to config. No explicit trust prompt is shown
  and

  no TLS fingerprint is pinned. A rogue device on the LAN can advertise itself as a gateway and have the

  user''s credentials sent to it (spoofing / MITM).

  '
cwe:
- CWE-295
- CWE-346
severity: medium
confidence: medium
languages:
- typescript
source:
  kind: fix-commit
  ref: d6affb17d85f5f5ab08ef9f2b994b257af12e75a
  vulnerable_ref: d6affb17d85f5f5ab08ef9f2b994b257af12e75a^
  patched_ref: d6affb17d85f5f5ab08ef9f2b994b257af12e75a
  repository: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw
rule:
  message: 'A URL is built from a discovered endpoint''s host/port and assigned without a trust confirmation

    (e.g. prompter.confirm) in the same block. Discovery data is unauthenticated; ask the user to

    trust the host and TLS fingerprint, and pin the fingerprint in config.

    '
  patterns:
  - pattern: '$URL = `wss://${$HOST}:${$PORT}`;

      ...

      '
  - pattern-inside: "if ($MODE === \"direct\") {\n  ...\n}\n"
  - pattern-not-inside: "if ($MODE === \"direct\") {\n  ...\n  await $PROMPTER.confirm({...});\n  ...\n\
      }\n"
fix:
  guidance: 'Before accepting a discovered endpoint for direct connection, show the host, port and advertised
    TLS

    fingerprint and require explicit confirmation with a default of "no". Abort if the user declines.

    Remember the fingerprint together with the exact URL that was trusted, and only save it as the

    remote tlsFingerprint when the final URL still equals the trusted one.

    '
  example: "if (mode === \"direct\") {\n  suggestedUrl = `wss://${host}:${port}`;\n  const fingerprint\
    \ = target.endpoint.gatewayTlsFingerprintSha256;\n  const trusted = await prompter.confirm({\n   \
    \ message: `Trust this gateway? ${host}:${port} TLS fingerprint: ${fingerprint ?? \"not advertised\"\
    }`,\n    initialValue: false,\n  });\n  if (!trusted) {\n    throw new Error(\"Discovery endpoint\
    \ not trusted.\");\n  }\n  discoveryTlsFingerprint = fingerprint;\n  trustedDiscoveryUrl = suggestedUrl;\n\
    }\n// ...\nremote: {\n  url,\n  ...(pinned ? { tlsFingerprint: pinned } : {}),\n}\n"
